findings.claim: Original 00490A00 visible-terrain selection/subdivision produces M06 adaptive leaf primitives with original vertex, edge and leaf writers; primary 267 vertices/172 leaves, contrast 97/41, rejected view 0/0.
findings.limitations: Controlled view, direct producer entry and declared numerical/peripheral services; stop before 004937C0 transform. Adaptive leaves are not flattened render polygons, pixels or live Windows evidence.

findings.claim: Every generated source-grid vertex height and every logged visual height/material read matches authenticated M06 TER bytes; selected original leaf source page/row/column/material classes independently identified.
findings.limitations: Exact pre-transform low12 lattice heights; source-world scale derived from original static transform. TER class is source metadata/LOD predicate input, not rendered texture identity; bit12 unresolved.

findings.claim: Retail polygon path 004922F0 writes record material/type B4, while alternate 004923F0/004924B0 obtains separate descriptor/global state; the tested TER class provenance does not establish rendered texture selection.
findings.limitations: Binary-static only downstream of adaptive leaf generation; neither polygon emitter, descriptor resource acquisition nor clip/draw is executed. No dynamic texture/UV claim.

findings.claim: Untreated Ghidra FPATAN at 00492EAF blocks the visible-bounds routine; host instruction service enables original adaptive production, while valid affine view, polygon ownership and material/raster initialization beyond 004937C0 remain untested.
findings.limitations: Raw original-instruction failure is measured. Positive runs deliberately stop at pre-transform entry, not a claimed full pipeline failure. Renderer material/image and RND-R2/I1/G-RND-05 remain open.
